source_read: https://turtlebay.co.uk/menu/bath (rendered in Chromium 2026-10-10 about 18:20-18:40 UTC; robots.txt has no rule covering /menu/ or /assets/site/); the page's own menu data (Contentful JSON the page loads from tb-menu-proxy.herokuapp.com/restaurant/<slug>) captured from the same page loads, never fetched separately; the same page loaded once each for winchester, blackpool and camden
not_verifiable: Allergens are published as a link only (allergen guide PDF, HTTP 200), so the contains column in data/chrome-inbox/turtle-bay/items.csv was compared with the pop-ups for completeness but is not shown in the app. Nothing could be compared against the PDF (not read). Calories only: the pop-ups print no protein, carbs, fat, sugars, saturates, salt, fibre or kJ.
notes: Independent method: a script clicked 'More info' on every visible dish of the Bath page (143 pop-ups from 146 menu items; the 3 Bottomless Brunch items are hidden by the page itself) and parsed the pop-up DOM (title, allergen list, 'N Kcals'), then cross-checked against the JSON the page loads. All 60 published rows: name, category (section title) and kcal identical in the pop-up and the JSON; the inbox contains column matches the pop-up allergen list for all 60 (the 12 pop-ups headed 'Caloric information for this dish' have no allergen list, matching the blank cells). Winchester, Blackpool and Camden print the same 139 dish names with identical kcal and allergens for every published dish, so 'same in all restaurants' holds for the 4 read; the menu dropdown lists 43 restaurants (the booking widget lists 42, without Walthamstow). Only drinks (19 with a kcal figure: cocktails, beers, soft drinks, non-alcoholic) are on the page with kcal and not published, by design; dishes that print no kcal are not published, as the note says. Figures copied as printed that look doubtful (the page does not contradict itself, so nothing is held back): Lamb Steak 183 kcal (a 17 pound main 'with sweet pineapple chow and parsley oil' while the page's own Pineapple Chow side alone prints 157), Sweet Plantain 581 (identical to the Mac & Cheese side's 581, in both the pop-up and the JSON), Miami Burger 274 (a bun burger, against 772-972 for the other burgers). Worth asking the chain; the founder decides whether to hold them back.
